Bug 2080984 [wpt PR 63572] - Drawing a BGRX VideoFrame should disregard the alpha component, a=testonly

SKIP_BMO_CHECK

RGBX and BGRX VideoFrames must be rendered as if they were opaque:.
The fourth byte of a pixel is padding, not alpha.
It was handled as alpha, so a padding byte of 0 made the frame transparent when drawn.

VideoFrame gets a virtual shouldIgnoreAlpha(), false by default.
- VideoFrameCV stores the flag and sets it in createRGBX/createBGRX and when
  alpha: 'discard' is used. VideoFrame::updateShouldIgnoreAlpha makes a cheap
  clone sharing the pixel buffer, so an RGBX frame made from an RGBA one is
  not deep copied. The pixel data is left untouched.
- VideoFrameCV::create takes a mandatory VideoFrameCV::ShouldIgnoreAlpha when
  given a color space. The overload computing the color space from the buffer
  has no flag; resize and asVideoFrameCV set it with updateShouldIgnoreAlpha.
- The flag is preserved by clone, rotation, resize, SharedVideoFrame and
  RemoteVideoFrameProxy properties.
- VideoFrameGStreamer needs no flag since it creates RGBx/BGRx frames.

When creating a VideoFrame from a HTMLVideoElement or HTMLImageElement, we are now using ShouldClone::Yes.
This is fixing an existing bug where if we create two WebCodecsVideoFrame from the same HTMLVideoElement synchronously,
we would use the same underlying VideoFrame, which is ok except if we are discarding alpha/changing timestamp in one but not the other.
By using ShouldClone::Yes, when updating, we will clone the VideoFrame around the same underlying resource.

Consumers use the flag as follows:
- VideoFrame::copyNativeImage creates images without alpha (kCGImageAlphaNoneSkipFirst).
- copyTo sets the X byte to 255 for RGBX/BGRX, and the RGBA/BGRA row copies
  now use vImage channel permutations instead of per byte loops.
- For WebGL texImage, the CG image extractor sets the skipped byte to 255 in
  a copy of the pixels when the upload format has an alpha component.
- Encoders convert RGB frames to YUV, which already drops alpha.

We update ImageTransferSessionVT::createPixelBuffer from a CGImageRef so that it preserves alpha.
We add a flag to allow this preservation.
We implement it by drawing on premultiplied alpha as CGBitmapContextCreate with kCGImageAlphaFirst does not work..

We add several tests to cover all consumers and alpha discard code paths.

WebKit-Bug: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=327231

copyTo for a BGRX/RGBX VideoFrame should succeed (#63566)

We add support for copyTo by reusing the same code path for BGRX as BGRA and RGBX/RGBA.
The WPT test is not fully complete as it should check the copyT X component.
This will be added when the spec is clear about what should be done.
